text:
maya: heads-up — nightly gpu-ci is red on the h100-parallel-smoke shard after the driver rollout. failing with mixed CUDA runtime errors and small memory OOMs. can someone kick a rerun and bisect?

infra-bot: CI job 81234 failed on runner h100-shard-7 (ubuntu22 + redwood/inference-ci:cuda13.4-driver-5432) — test shard: smoke/parallel/llm_inference_small.

maya: log snippet:```
E tensorflow: cuda_runtime.cc:78: CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_IMAGE: invalid argument in cudaLaunchKernel
2026-03-17T02:12:08Z ERROR: allocation failed: tried to alloc 2048MiB, available 128MiB
Stack (most recent): launch_kernel -> alloc_gpu_tensor -> cuLaunchKernel -> CUDARuntimeError(78)
```

toni: @maya thanks. looks like a driver vs kernel mismatch after the image flip. can we rerun with the previous pinned driver image (5431) to confirm? also please file a bisect if rerun flips green.

sam: I can do quick bisect — what's the suspect range? last good on ci was 2360000000 (driver 5430) and image flip to 5432 happened in commit a1b2c3d. can you add the commit + full failing test id?

maya: commit a1b2c3d -> a1b2c3d: bump image to cuda13.4-driver-5432; failing test id smoke/parallel/llm_inference_small:shard7. repro locally shows intermittent invalid-device-function when running 4 threads parallel.

lee: also seeing small OOM spikes on h100 with quantized attention microbenchmarks — might be allocator regression. try set `TF_FORCE_CPU_ALLOW_GROWTH=1` and `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` for the rerun to get better stacks.

toni: good debugging tips. infra — could you queue a policy-rerun pinned to driver 5431 and then one with 5432 + debug env? we need both to triage. @infra-bot can you? :eyes:

infra-bot: @toni queued reruns:
- run 81234-rerun-pinned-5431 (priority: high)
- run 81234-rerun-debug-5432 (env overrides: TF_FORCE_CPU_ALLOW_GROWTH=1, CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1)
Queue IDs: 81234-01, 81234-02. ETA ~10m per shard.

maya: thanks. if pinned-5431 goes green then it's driver regression. if both fail, probably a change in runtime or allocator. sam — if you can start a bisection on the driver commits between 5430..5432 that'd be great.

sam: will start bisect on canary nodes. plan: run smoke with single-job and 4-job parallel to reproduce. will attach CI logs to ticket RD-9876.

lee: FYI I also opened an internal ticket to get driver vendor to sanity-check the PTX symbols: ticket DV-214. linking once sam posts logs.

maya: small follow-ups: please don't rebase the failing PRs until we confirm root cause; ping me if rerun shows different OOM sizes. adding @sam and @toni to RD-9876 once logs land. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Rerun 81234-01 started on h100-shard-7 (pinned-5431).

toni: thanks infra. if 81234-01 still fails, take a snapshot of /var/log/nvidia* and `nvidia-smi -q` output and paste here.

maya: noted. I'll watch the runs — will report back with results and attach logs to ticket.

sam: quick note — if bisect reproduces, I'll attempt a minimal repro harness to isolate which PTX change triggered invalid-device-function. should have first results in ~45m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

lee: sounds good. thanks all — appreciate quick help.

maya: closing loop: rerun queued, bisect in flight, infra+driver vendor notified. will update RD-9876 with status. :white_check_mark:
